actual_final_archive_verification: Performed separately after manifest freeze; see detached finalization receipt
validated_scope: Current scoped plan, typed raw, time, sign, calibration and repeat ancestry
Failed-attempt, independent safe-state and accepted custody accounting
Exact bounded sanitized text-export rules and adversarial ZIP byte envelope checks
Source coverage, numerical/experimental distinctions, table inventory and shared scene IDs
not_validated: Hardware safety or any physical operation
Robot motion, grasp, contact, collision or dynamics
Acoustic/optical/force calibration and production receipt authentication
Whole-study cross-specimen aggregation or independent experimental replication
Exhaustive publisher update status or supporting raw-data inventory
test_count_semantics: Counts are unittest methods; many have multiple subcases. Neither methods nor subcases count as experiments or safety proofs.
paired_scene: Exact scene ZIP, scene core, native BLEND, GLB and shared contract hashes bound in paired_asset_reference.json
